section_summary.extract_value: This section defines various conceptualizations of humor, including sense of humor, humor comprehension, humor appreciation, and humor production ability. The present study focuses on humor production ability, considering it most akin to creativity. It describes different assessment approaches for humor production, such as self-report questionnaires, external assessments, and objective performance measures like the Cartoon Production Punchline Test (CPPT), which evaluates punch lines across categories like incongruity-resolution, nonsense, and sexual humor.
